name: Don't Trust Him
source:
You got saved by a pirate while drowning. You seem to not be able to remember anything from your past. Now that you are stuck with four pretty boys, you try to get your memory back while romancing them. However, things are getting weirder each day. Don't you think it's suspicious? It's up to you to decide and find out the truth as you play!

[From [url=https://artisticvillain.itch.io/donttrusthim]Itch.io[/url]]
